## REVENUE — URGENT PRIORITY

**Revenue collapse from June (£17,711) to July (£1,363) is a catastrophic red flag.** This is NOT seasonal; active clients held at 151, so the studio is there. Your invoicing or membership collection system has broken. Check: (1) Are July memberships actually collected or logged as AR? (2) Has your payment processor failed or been misconfigured post-relocation? (3) Are clients on free trial or payment-hold post-move? This must be diagnosed and fixed within 48 hours — you're leaving £15k+ on the table.

- **Churn spiked post-relocation (8.33% in April, 5.74% in May, 6.60% in March).** June recovered to 0% retention — hold that. Implement post-relocation win-back campaign: 1-to-1 check-ins with members who paused, free class vouchers for referrals, 3-month lock-in contracts at slight discount to stabilise base.

Target 180+ members by end of Q3. Audit class utilisation by day/time; move underbooked classes to peak slots or introduce weekend small-group training at £25–40/session.

# Service Menu Build — Execution Plan for Grace

• **Audit what you're *actually* selling right now** — Have Grace (or a coach) document every variation members are currently paying for: membership tiers, personal training packages, class bundles, nutrition add-ons, challenges, corporate rates. You likely have 3-4 hidden offerings already. Don't invent new ones yet.

• **Split into two ruthless documents:** (1) **Coach-facing** — cost-to-deliver, margins, upsell logic, package boundaries so they stop improvising discounts. (2) **Member-facing** — stripped of jargon, outcome-focused ("6-week strength reset £89" not "PPL periodization package"). Make the member version so clear someone buying at 11pm on their phone gets it.

• **Price by anchoring to your top performer** — Find your most popular offering (probably a membership + personal training combo). That's your baseline. Everything else scales from it. Don't guess pricing; look at what members are already paying willingly.

• **Build it in a shared Google Sheet TODAY, not a fancy PDF later** — Grace needs her coaches feeding real data into it weekly. A living document beats a polished one that's wrong. Once it stabilizes (2-3 weeks), *then* design the pretty version for the website/studio walls.

• **Field-test with 3 members this week** — Have them "shop" the menu verbally. Where do they pause? Where's the confusion? That tells you what to clarify before launch.
